map.齿轮中心距 a=m(z1+z2)/2、传动比 i=z2/z1。: Gear centre distance a = m(z1+z2)/2, transmission ratio i = z2/z1.
map.凸轮基圆半径与最大压力角校核。: Cam base circle radius and maximum pressure angle check.
map.：最短+最长 ≤ 其余两杆和（Grashof 定理）方可整周回转；否则为双摇杆。: : Shortest + longest <= the sum of the other two rods (Grashof's theorem) is required for full rotation; otherwise it is a double rocker. For example 20+100 <= 40+60 = 100 takes equality, the critical case.
map.中心距为何等于两分度圆半径和？: Why does the centre distance equal the sum of the two pitch radii?
map.标准安装时分度圆相切，节圆=分度圆，故 a=(d1+d2)/2=m(z1+z2): In standard mounting the pitch circles are tangent and the pitch circle equals the reference circle, so a = (d1+d2)/2 = m(z1+z2)/2.
map.压力角越大越好？: Is a larger pressure angle better?
map.不是。压力角大传力好但效率低、易自锁；标准取 20°，小轮受限时校核最大压力角。: No. A larger pressure angle transmits force better but lowers efficiency and easily self-locks; 20 degrees is standard, and the maximum pressure angle is checked when the small wheel is constrained.
